I am the wind!

I don't care what shape we're in. They're not taking this camp.
I don't dare imagine what the Inquest plans to do with these research pods. I'd rather ruin them than have them remain in evil hands. Go on. Destroy the research pods. All of them!

I greet you like the sky greets the sea.

I helped Yahala Scribepaw test the Priory's latest invention, a device that can detect the necromancer Rissa's amulets. Yahala and I decided to return to Hero's Canton to meet with the Rytlock and the other order reps to put a stop to the necromancer's plans once and for all...and to find out what really happened to Howl the Brazen's body.

I helped the survivors of the Pact fleet disaster regroup and establish defenses against recurring Mordrem attacks. I also mastered the basics of glider flight to better navigate this treacherous terrain. I've heard reports of a potentially friendly, local hylek tribe and have decided to make contact; their familiarity with this region will help us locate Trahearne and Destiny's Edge.
I hope I can help.

I require assistance!
I require more energy.
I return to the air.
I returned to Logan. He confided that he is too close to the queen, and believes it could be clouding his judgment. To be safe, he left the decision of how to protect the queen up to me.
